item.tib: pha rgyud rig pa khu byug gsang mchog mthar thug rgyal po'i rgyud las ye shes mtshon cha'i bsad pa'i 'phyong
item.coloph: dbal gsang mchog rig pa khu byug rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ gzhung las gud du bkol ba'i las kha ye shes mtshon cha bsad pa'i 'phyong zhes bya ba/ dbal bon stag la me 'bar gyis gtan la phab pa rdzogs so// rim par brgyud nas las ldan sprul pa'i gshen blo ldan snying po la brgyud cing 'phel ba'i dge zhing dar rgyas yun gnas shog
